metadata.title: Ach Gadol — Big Brother for Lone Soldiers
metadata.description: All the rights, information, and guidance for lone soldiers in the IDF — in one place. Eligibility checker, smart chatbot, and hundreds of volunteers at your service.

hero.title: All the rights you deserve — in one place
hero.subtitle: Smart chatbot, personalized eligibility check, and professional guidance — so you get everything you're entitled to as a lone soldier.
hero.badge: Big Brother Organization for Lone Soldiers

about.title: About Ach Gadol
about.description: Ach Gadol is a nonprofit organization dedicated to supporting lone soldiers in the IDF. We're here to make sure every lone soldier knows their rights and receives the support they need.
about.presidential_award: Recipients of the Presidential Volunteer Award
about.mission: Our mission is to be the big brother for every lone soldier — to accompany, support, and ensure access to all the rights and resources they deserve.

rights.title: Lone Soldier Rights & Benefits
rights.subtitle: We've gathered all the rights and benefits available to lone soldiers — grants, housing, leave days, and more.
rights.not_sure_title: Not sure which rights apply to you?
rights.not_sure_description: Use our eligibility checker to find out exactly which benefits you are entitled to and the estimated monthly total.

check.title: Personalized Eligibility Check
check.subtitle: Answer a few short questions and discover which rights and benefits you're entitled to.

soldier_types.lone_classic: Classic Lone Soldier (new immigrant without family in Israel)

soldier_types.foster_family: Graduate of foster care or institutional care

check.is_combat: Are you in a combat role?
check.disclaimer: These results are for general estimation only and do not constitute legal advice. Final eligibility is determined by the relevant authorities.

chat.title: Ask Ach Gadol
chat.placeholder: Ask any question about rights, service, or anything else...
chat.welcome: Hi there! I'm the Ach Gadol chatbot. I'm happy to help with any questions about lone soldier rights, grants, housing, or anything else. How can I help?
chat.escalate: Want to speak with a real volunteer? Click here.
chat.disclaimer: The chatbot provides general information only and does not replace professional advice. If in doubt, reach out to our volunteers.
chat.quick_rights_msg: What rights am I entitled to as a lone soldier?
chat.quick_forms_msg: What forms do I need to fill out as a lone soldier?
chat.quick_volunteer_msg: I'd like to speak with a volunteer
chat.error_message: Sorry, something went wrong. Please try again or contact a volunteer for help.
